name: Sacha Bucquet Janequin
original_name: サーシャ＝ビュケ＝ジャヌカン
source:
[url=/c9484]Ursule[/url]'s maid, thinks highly of herself and oftens pranks her master with Luna by introducing her to false conceptions about Japan and the Japanese language.

[spoiler]It is later revealed that Sacha was once one of [url=/c25531]Jean-Pierre[/url]'s oldest and capable employees, and that she had feelings for him for accepting her for who she is.[/spoiler]
